title: Samsung T7 Shield not detected
shortDescription: Portable SSD doesn't appear on host.
fullDescription: T7/T7 Shield enumeration failures are usually cable, port, or firmware related. Samsung Magician can detect internal issues the OS won't.

fixSteps.title: Firmware via Magician
fixSteps.instruction: Install Samsung Magician and update firmware.

title: TRIM not passing to Samsung SSD
fullDescription: External enclosures or RAID controllers may block TRIM. Magician reports TRIM status; enable where possible.

causes.cause: macOS default disables TRIM on external

fixSteps.title: Upgrade enclosure
fixSteps.instruction: UASP-capable enclosure required for TRIM passthrough.

title: Samsung SSD throttling
fullDescription: 980 Pro and other high-end drives throttle aggressively when controller temperatures exceed ~70°C, which is common in M.2 slots without heatsinks. T7 also thermally throttles; T7 Shield has better sustained speeds.

fixSteps.title: Add heatsink (internal)
fixSteps.instruction: For 980 Pro, install an M.2 heatsink.

fixSteps.title: Airflow
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure case airflow around M.2 slot / external SSD.

title: Samsung SSD firmware outdated
shortDescription: Firmware update available – stability and speed fixes.
fullDescription: Samsung released critical firmware fixes for 980 Pro (and 990 Pro) to address rapid health degradation. Updating is essential.

fixSteps.title: Back up
fixSteps.instruction: Always back up before firmware update.

fixSteps.title: Verify version
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm current firmware version after update.

whenToCallPro: If drive bricks during update, Samsung support/RMA.

faq.a: Firmware fix (3B2QGXA7+) addressed rapid health drop bug.

title: Samsung SSD SMART critical warning
fullDescription: Magician SMART warning. Attributes like Available Spare or Media Errors have gone beyond threshold. Back up and replace drive.

faq.a: Up to rated TBW; beyond not.

title: Samsung SSD over-temperature
shortDescription: SSD hit thermal limit – throttle or shutdown.
fullDescription: 980 Pro regularly exceeds 70°C without heatsink. Portable T7 also reaches 60-65°C in alu case. Beyond ~80°C drives throttle or disconnect to protect hardware.

fixSteps.title: Airflow
fixSteps.instruction: Improve case airflow; external SSDs on metal stand.

title: Samsung SSD bad blocks rising
fullDescription: Normal at low rates; rising count signals wear-out. 980 Pro known health drop issue mitigated via firmware update.

fixSteps.title: Firmware update
fixSteps.instruction: Apply Samsung firmware fix if 980 Pro.

whenToCallPro: Data recovery if can't back up.

faq.a: Some early units had firmware bug now patched.

title: Samsung SSD went read-only
shortDescription: Drive writes blocked due to self-protection.
fullDescription: Drives entering end-of-life may lock into read-only to preserve data. Pull your data and retire drive.

title: Samsung SSD I/O errors
fullDescription: I/O errors point to firmware, cable, or NAND issues. Back up before further troubleshooting.

title: Samsung T7 password lock
shortDescription: Drive locked by Samsung Portable SSD software.
fullDescription: Samsung Portable SSD software sets AES-256 password; forgotten password renders data unrecoverable.
symptoms: Samsung Portable SSD app prompts password

fixSteps.title: Install software
fixSteps.instruction: Download latest Samsung Portable SSD app.

fixSteps.title: Reset destroys data
fixSteps.instruction: Factory reset in app only clears data – resets password but loses everything.

whenToCallPro: Pro recovery unlikely to help with hardware AES.

faq.a: No – password is not recoverable by Samsung.
